original_ai_output.title_zh: 南非难民面临紧张局势升级，9月30日最后期限临近
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南非一个反移民运动组织发出9月30日最后期限，要求无证外国公民离境，引发移民社区普遍焦虑。该组织名为March and March，今年以来已发起多场抗议活动，并警告若诉求未获满足将举行更多示威。目前仅有一个来源报道此事。

key_facts.fact: 南非反移民运动组织发出9月30日最后期限，要求无证外国公民离境
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: An impending September 30 deadline issued by an anti-immigration movement has ignited profound anxiety across migrant communities in South Africa.

key_facts.fact: 该组织名为March and March，今年以来已发起多场抗议活动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The group, known as March and March, has spearheaded protests throughout the year demanding that undocumented foreign nationals leave the country.

key_facts.fact: 组织者警告若诉求未获满足将举行更多示威
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Organisers warn of further demonstrations if their demands remain unmet.
